push notification.note: Established: 'Servidor de Notificação Push', 'notificações push'. 'Push' stays in English.

bottom sheet.note: No existing translation; 'painel inferior' is the common pt-BR rendering for the Material Design bottom sheet. Rarely user-facing.

long-press.note: Android pt-BR docs use 'tocar e segurar' and iOS uses 'manter pressionado'; 'pressionar e segurar' reads naturally in both contexts.

tap.note: One existing string uses 'Clique', which is a desktop term — use 'tocar'/'toque' on mobile.

toast.note: Developer-facing term, commonly untranslated in pt-BR. If a user-facing rendering is needed, use 'aviso temporário'.

clipboard.note: 'copiado para a área de transferência' for 'copied to clipboard'.

biometrics.note: Adjective: 'autenticação biométrica' (established in webapp admin strings).

passcode.note: Matches existing 'PIN/código de acesso' in the mobile-security admin strings.

screen lock.note: Matches existing 'protegido com um bloqueio de tela'.

jailbroken.note: 'dispositivos com jailbreak ou root' ('rooted' = 'com root'). Existing strings vary ('com Jailbroken', 'desbloqueados'); prefer 'com jailbreak'.

app logs.note: 'Log' stays in English (masculine) per existing desktop/webapp usage; all-caps label: 'LOGS DO APLICATIVO'.

deep link.note: Commonly untranslated in pt-BR tech writing; Google's Android docs use 'link direto' if a translation is required.

skin tone.note: Established in emoji picker strings; 'tom de pele padrão' for default skin tone.

server connection.note: UI actions follow existing patterns: 'Adicionar um servidor' (Add a server), 'Trocar de servidor' (Switch server).
